reviewContext.userProblem: An operator or automated agent (the later ART output monitor) must, using only the riela CLI and without restarting RielaApp.app (0.3.1, profile default), reload a resident App workflow instance definition/source/event bindings, trigger a manual configured run with App-held credentials, and inspect recent executions as JSON. Today `riela instance` has only list|show|create|update|remove, list identities fail in show (no App-profile branch in findInPrecedence), `restart` kills in-flight runs and never re-reads the definition store head or a moved source directory, and the App listener is not on 19091 despite web-server.json isEnabled:true because startIfRequested only honours --start-web-server (design §2).
requiredOutcomes: Identities printed by `riela instance list` are accepted by `riela instance show` and the new commands; App-only identities are read-only for update/remove with instance_app_scope_read_only; selected-workflow: workflowId normalization (design D3; plan 04).

`riela instance reload <identity> --reason <text> [--workflow-definition-dir <dir>] [--interrupt-running] [--wait-idle] [--timeout-seconds N]` drives a new desktop-only POST /api/v1/instances/{identity}/reload that validates before any write, force/seed-imports the definition head, relinks a changed source, refreshes the cache and replaces the events-serve child only when the installed start record differs, behind a child admission barrier; in-flight runs untouched unless --interrupt-running; JSON output with closed response fields (design D4; plans 01, 05-09).

`riela instance run <identity> [--variables <json|@file>] [--wait] [--timeout-seconds N]` posts to the existing /runs API, prints launchId/sessionId/status and optionally waits for completion (design D5; plan 04).

`riela instance executions <identity> [--limit N]` prints recent executions with sessionId, status, startedAt, endedAt, updatedAt, currentStepId as JSON; the App projection adds startedAt/endedAt additively (design D5, D6; plans 02, 04).

CLI auto-discovers the App endpoint (<appRoot>/web-server.json, default 19091) and active profile (<appRoot>/active-profile.json) read-only, overridable by --server/--profile; root cause fixed: App autostarts the listener when persisted isEnabled is true (design D1, D2; plans 03, 04).

Focused unit/integration tests for argument validation, request construction, error mapping, reload swap semantics, admission gate races and identity normalization; swift build and the focused filters pass.
Docs docs/app-instance-control.md, README pointer, riela-workflow-run skill pointer, and the one-time App upgrade prerequisite (design D7; plan 10).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Use the existing loopback App HTTP API (bootstrap -> csrf, x-riela-profile, expectedRevision) through a new RielaAppAPIClient rather than a file-based control queue.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The running 0.3.1 App can start its listener without restart from Console > Settings; HTTP keeps existing auth semantics (design §2, D1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Root-cause fix: start the listener at launch when launchOptions.startsWebServer || settings.isEnabled.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Implements lifecycle design §2.2; isEnabled is only set by an explicit user Start, so no new exposure; one-time App upgrade documented (D2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: App instances are resolved by show/new commands after project -> user precedence; update/remove on App-only identities fail as read-only instead of writing shadow project instances.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: daemon-workflows.json is held in App memory and never re-read; CLI writes would not reach the running App (D3).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: New explicit reload route instead of reusing `restart`: validate candidate before any write, import with head-aware seed/force (DR-002), relink source, refresh cache, and respawn the events-serve child only when the installed start record (dir, event root, event-root digest, trigger-defaults fingerprint) differs (DR-003).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: restart kills in-flight runs and re-reads neither the definition store head nor a moved source; definition-only reloads need no respawn because every run resolves through the definition store (D4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Child-side actor-serialized admission gate driven by admission-close/confirm/open frames over the existing --runtime-environment-channel, with a 120 s lease; closed-gate cron fires and non-cron events are recorded as skipped/rejected reload-handoff receipts (replayable).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Parent-side snapshots race with cron ticks; admit and close on one actor guarantee a dispatch is either counted or refused (D4 step 6).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Port-driven RielaAppInstanceReloadCoordinator in RielaAppSupport, reusable validation/import/fingerprint library in RielaCLI, App glue in RielaApp.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Package.swift layering: RielaApp depends on RielaCLI and RielaAppSupport; the coordinator is fully testable with fakes, the library with real SQLite stores in RielaCLITests (plans 07-09).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Confirm expired/non-idle after commit returns HTTP 200 handoff:lost without replacing the child; the CLI maps it to exit 1 reload_handoff_lost and the installed record does not advance, so the next reload retries the respawn.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Never replace a child while work may be running unless --interrupt-running; recovery stays deterministic (D4 step 8, DR-003).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Three dependency waves: W1 {01 contracts, 02 executions projection, 03 webserver autostart, 04 CLI commands}; W2 {05 child gate, 06 parent runtime, 07 reload library, 08 coordinator} on 01; W3 {09 App route on 01/06/07/08, 10 docs on 04/09}.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Plan 01 pins all shared types so W2 plans run in parallel; every shared file has a single owner.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 1: SwiftPM build output is authorized as artifactRoots in two serialized build lanes. Lane A owns .build and runs 04 -> 05 -> 07, then 09 -> 10. Lane B owns tmp/instance-control/swiftpm-lane-b and runs 03 -> 08 -> 06. Lane B is seeded with APFS clones of .build/checkouts, repositories and artifacts plus a path-rewritten workspace-state.json, and every lane-B swift build/test passes --scratch-path tmp/instance-control/swiftpm-lane-b. The added dependsOn edges exist only for resource ordering. Before the first lane-B build, df -k . must show at least 10485760 KiB available; otherwise the plan records a disk-space blocker and deletes nothing. No source writePaths, contracts or design changed.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The blocked plans 03, 04, 05, 06, 07 and 08 (instance-control-03-webserver-autostart, -04-cli-commands, -05-child-admission-gate, -06-parent-admission-runtime, -07-reload-support-library, -08-reload-coordinator) were dispatched with artifactRoots [], so their required swift build/test output in .build was unauthorized. Each artifact root now equals one of its plan's writePaths and is absent from sharedPaths, and no two same-level plans share a root. Per-plan scratch roots were rejected because only about 31 GiB was free and six cold debug builds at 3-4 GB each could fill the disk. The previous checkpoint was f0f423aa7eb86fe3f6e8f91ff841694a0e5b951f. Plans 01 and 02 were accepted in wave 1 and are recorded as acceptedDependencies.

intentionalTradeoffs: Children started without --runtime-environment-channel cannot do a non-interrupting handoff; reload returns instance_handoff_unavailable unless --interrupt-running.
A narrow fingerprint race remains if an out-of-band definition update lands before the child starts.
Force import discards store-only definition edits (audited with the operator reason).
instance run/executions work against App 0.3.1 once the listener is started from Settings; reload and startedAt/endedAt need a one-time App upgrade; live end-to-end reload is unverifiable until then.
Wave siblings share one working tree and .build; mitigated by sibling-blocked recording, re-runs and serial integration; plan 05 requires 3 consecutive green runs.
supportedEdgeCases: Identity present in project and App (project wins); identity in two App profiles (ambiguousIdentity unless --profile).
Missing or corrupt web-server.json (default port 19091, file untouched); bootstrap profile mismatch (app_profile_conflict, no write).
App 0.3.1 without /reload (app_reload_unsupported); unreachable App (app_unreachable with Settings hint); unsafe server error codes (app_http_<status>).
Definition-only reload while a run is active (no admission frames, handoff none).
Binding/triggerDefaults change with running or queued work (instance_run_in_flight, --wait-idle retries, --interrupt-running).
Admission lease expiry / confirm expired (handoff lost, record not advanced, later reload recovers).
Fresh store (seeded), unchanged files (unchanged), concurrent seeder (forced retry), staleHead (definition_conflict, no write).
Invalid workflow.json, workflow id mismatch, invalid .riela-events bindings, unknown node patch id (422, no write).
Relink failure after import (configuration_io_failure, committed true, partial definition); child start failure (instance_start_failed, committed true).
Run launch with null sessionId (polling), launch record expired (executions-detail fallback), wait timeout, failed run.
Old session snapshots without createdAt (startedAt null).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Spawning real events-serve children or mutating the live App in tests.
Reloading instances in profiles other than the App's active profile without --profile.
